asset.Name: Aircraft Costs -50%
asset.Description:
Halves the purchase price and the monthly upkeep of every Xenonaut aircraft. Material costs, stats and weapons stay as in the base game.

PURCHASE PRICE
- Interceptors: $250,000 / $375,000 / $600,000 (was $500,000 / $750,000 / $1,200,000)
- Dropships: $150,000 / $250,000 / $500,000 (was $300,000 / $500,000 / $1,000,000)

MONTHLY UPKEEP
- Every aircraft: -50% (interceptors $50,000 / $75,000 / $100,000, was $100,000 / $150,000 / $200,000)
- The Soviet Union regional bonus still cuts upkeep by a further 25% of the base value.

COMPATIBILITY
- Replaces the six aircraft construction projects and the aircraft upkeep multiplier: do not use together with any mod that edits the same files.
- Works with Better Aircraft, Aircraft Weapons +25%, Better Base and Finance x3.
